src/crawler/crawl.ts: runCrawl() full orchestration - robots fetch (always, evidence) -> alias-remap robots.sitemaps before discoverSitemaps (plan-review round-2 fix) -> sitemap entry seeding (remap->normalize->isInScope->robots gate) -> single considerUrl() gate reused by every discovery path (caps/scope/robots/dedup+source-merge) -> CheerioCrawler primary pass with self-recursive html-link enqueue -> auto-mode outer loop alternating cheerio pass <-> playwright escalation pass (toRenderThisPass Map collected during cheerio pass, consumed after it finishes, newly-discovered rendered-DOM links feed the NEXT cheerio pass rather than self-enqueuing into playwright) -> never mode = cheerio-only single pass -> always mode = playwright-only self-recursive single pass -> failedRequestHandler classifies timeout/dns/redirect-loop/parse-error/other -> non-2xx pages get both a CrawledPage AND a FailureRecord -> non-HTML content-type gets FailureRecord 'other', no extraction -> saveBlocked/saveReport at the end

Redirect chain: Cheerio pass uses a manual fetch(redirect:'manual') hop-by-hop walk (got's response.redirectUrls only gives URLs, no per-hop status) capped at 8 hops, sentinel statusCode=0 if a hop trace fails (never fabricates a plausible-looking 3xx). Playwright pass uses native request.redirectedFrom() chain walk - real per-hop status for free, no extra fetch.

responseTimeMs: Cheerio uses got's response.timings.phases.total (real, confirmed typed and populated in a live run). Playwright measures via a preNavigationHooks timestamp stashed on request.userData.
